papers.title: Dynamically adaptive soft bioelectronics for neuro-immunomodulatory cancer therapy
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Many solid tumors remain refractory to immunotherapy due to profoundly immunosuppressive tumor microenvironments. Although vagus nerve stimulation offers a direct neural axis to reprogram immune function, its potential in cancer immunotherapy remains unrealized due to the absence of stable, system-level neuromodulation platforms. Herein, we develop a miniature subdiaphragmatic vagus nerve stimulator (SVNS) for near-organ neuromodulation of pancreatic tumor immunity. To construct stable electrical coupling with subdiaphragmatic vagus nerve (SVN) along the esophagus, a dynamically adaptive neural interface comprising an injectable anti-fatigue adhesive conductive hydrogel and a deformable liquid metal electrode is explored. The SVNS is integrated with a battery-free lead-free wireless power module, which can be configured into a Swiss-roll architecture, enabling minimally invasive implantation. In an orthotopic mouse model of pancreatic tumor, chronic SVN stimulation using SVNS suppressed tumor growth and metastasis, reshaped tumor innervation, promoted a shift toward an M1-like TAM phenotype, enhanced cytotoxic immune cell infiltration, and further potentiated the efficacy of anti-PD-1 immunotherapy.
papers.summary_ko: 미주신경 자극을 통한 췌장암 면역치료를 위한 동적 적응형 소프트 생체전자소자에 관한 연구. 전도성 하이드로젤과 액체금속 전극, 무전지 무선 전력 모듈을 결합해 종양 미세환경을 재프로그래밍하는 내용으로, 배터리 소재/전기화학과는 무관함.

papers.title: Flame Retardant Lithium Composites With Synergistic Suppression of Lithium Dendrites and Smoke Toxicity for High Safe Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium metal batteries (LMBs) are regarded as the promising next‑generation high energy density storage, but their commercialization is hindered by uncontrolled Li dendrite growth and the persistent risk of thermal runaway. Herein, a multifunctional artificial interface membrane is designed through electrospinning combined with in situ metal‐organic framework (MOF) growth, aiming to construct a highly safe lithium metal anode. The uniformly dispersed MOF nanoparticles in the membrane generate uniform Li + flux through their inherent cage window structure, effectively inhibiting excessive Li dendrite formation and thereby stabilizing the lithium metal anode with improved cycling stability. Notably, the membrane exhibits strong adsorption and catalytic ability for hazardous CO gases released during thermal runaway, enabling valid conversion of CO to CO 2 . Importantly, the ignition time of the as‐prepared Li metal composite anode is significantly prolonged, providing a valuable time window for battery fire accident response and personnel rescue. This work demonstrates a multifunctionally flame retardant interface protective layer design method through integrated interfacial and rational material structure engineering. It leads to a new strategy for synergistic suppression of Li dendrites and smoke toxicity in future safe LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 전기방사와 금속-유기 골격체(MOF)의 현장 성장을 결합해 리튬 금속 음극용 다기능 난연성 인공 보호막을 설계함. MOF 나노입자의 균일한 Li+ 플럭스 유도로 덴드라이트 성장을 억제하고 사이클 안정성을 개선하며, 열폭주 시 발생하는 유해 CO 가스를 CO2로 전환하고 발화 시간을 크게 연장시켜 리튬 금속 전지의 안전성을 동시에 확보함.

papers.title: Cyanide‐Driven Nitrite Trapping Enables Robustly‐Coupled Gel/Cathode Interfaces in Zinc‐Air Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Gel zinc‐air batteries (GZABs) are promising for flexible energy storage. However, their performance is often limited by unstable gel cathode interfaces, where water‐dependent OH − transport, charge transfer, and mechanical adhesion are closely linked. Here, we propose an interfacial coupling chemistry by using a cobalt‐based Prussian blue analogue (CCN) as a reconstructable precatalyst. When assembled with a polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) gel electrolyte and electrochemically activated during the GZAB operation, CCN was reconstructed into a sheet‐arrayed amorphous CoOOH while releasing cyanide‐derived nitrogen that was confined by the gel network and converted into −NO 2 groups at the PVA/CoOOH interface. These NO 2 groups act as molecular linkers, chemically coupling with CoOOH through Co–N–O bonding and reinforcing hydrogen bonding with the PVA chains. The in situ reconstructed electrode exhibits enhanced interfacial OH − transport, with an apparent diffusion coefficient 3.25 times that of the ex situ construction, together with lower interfacial resistance and stronger mechanical adhesion. Benefiting from both the reconstructed CoOOH catalyst and coupling interface, the resulting GZAB delivers a peak power density of 144 mW cm −2 and maintains 86.4 mW cm −2 even at 30% water content. The enhanced interfacial adhesion further enables stable operation in omnidirectionally flexible cable‐type zinc‐air batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 유연 겔 아연-공기전지에서 불안정한 겔 양극 계면 문제를, 코발트 기반 프러시안블루 유사체(CCN)를 재구성 가능한 전촉매로 사용한 계면 결합 화학으로 해결했다. 전기화학적 활성화 중 CCN이 시트형 비정질 CoOOH로 재구성되면서 방출된 시아나이드 유래 질소가 PVA/CoOOH 계면에서 -NO2기로 전환되어 CoOOH와 Co-N-O 결합을 형성하고 PVA 사슬과 수소결합을 강화한다. 이 전지는 144 mW cm-2의 피크 출력밀도와 30% 수분 함량에서도 86.4 mW cm-2를 유지했다.

papers.title: Copper-organic framework composite polyether electrolyte with valence-responsive electronic modulation toward high-performance solid-state lithium metal batteries
papers.abstract_en: The narrow electrochemical window and persistent dendrite growth of in situ polymerized poly(1,3-dioxolane) (PDOL) solid-state electrolytes remain critical bottlenecks for high-energy-density lithium-metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: In situ 중합된 PDOL 고체전해질의 좁은 전기화학적 창과 지속적인 덴드라이트 성장 문제를 해결하기 위한 구리-유기 골격체 복합 폴리에터 전해질을 다룬 연구로, 밸런스-반응성 전자 조절을 통해 고성능 전고체 리튬 금속전지를 구현한 것으로 추정된다. (제목 기반 추정)

papers.title: Coordination-induced fluorescence red shift of carbon dots regulates interfacial chemistry for ultra-stable and low-temperature adaptive zinc-ion batteries
papers.abstract_en: Zn 2+ coordination couples the optical and electronic evolution of carbon dots with Zn interfacial chemistry, enabling homogeneous deposition, low-temperature adaptability, and ultra-stable cycling over 72 000 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: 탄소점(carbon dot)의 Zn2+ 배위에 따른 형광 적색 이동을 이용해 광학적/전자적 변화와 아연 계면 화학을 결합시킨 연구이다. 이를 통해 균일한 Zn 증착과 저온 적응성, 72000회 사이클의 초안정적 구동을 아연이온전지에서 달성했다.
